verdict.rationale: The pack shows only glancing support for this story. There are keyboard shortcuts in the editor (`[[` to link, `cmd j` for the AI palette). A user describes the app as "beautiful, fast" with an easy interface. Another user's note that uploaded files and images aren't E2E-encrypted implies media can be added to notes. None of the core formatting elements are documented. Missing for 10: documented support for headings, callouts, tables, and code blocks; explicit docs on embedding media; a documented keyboard shortcut and slash-command reference for formatting; hands-on corroboration of the editor's formatting capabilities.
